name: ButtonAttributeEditor
src_typeComment: Applies to every MonoBehaviour's Inspector: draws the normal fields, then adds a button for each parameterless method marked [Button]. No per-script custom Editor needed — this one covers everything automatically. Note: this registers globally for MonoBehaviour, so it's the Inspector shown for any script that doesn't already have its own more specific [CustomEditor] (Unity always prefers the most specific match, so scripts with their own custom Editor are unaffected).
